permissions.description: List of permissions granted to this API key

distribution_wallet_ids.description: IDs of the distribution accounts this key may act on. Omit the field to leave the key's current accounts unchanged; providing a list replaces them. An empty array removes all account access. A key cannot be scoped to an account the caller cannot reach.

oneOf.description: Single IP address or CIDR range
Array of IP addresses or CIDR ranges

allowed_ips.description: IP restrictions for the API key. If not provided, existing restrictions remain unchanged
